subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The subsequent QR codes will __helping you access__ the data.
solution:
The correct answer is: "help you access".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the original sentence is the use of the verb "**helping**" after "**will**."
 
• The correct form should be "help," not "helping."
 
• When using the future tense with "will," the base form of the verb (in this case, "help") should be used without "ing."
 
• "**Help**" is the correct base form of the verb to convey that something will aid or assist in the future.
 
• So, "**will help**" is the appropriate construction to indicate that the subsequent QR codes will assist you in accessing the data.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence**: *The subsequent QR codes will help you access the data. *
